headline: BASF Lifts 2026 Profit Outlook on Iran War Price Hikes
summary: German chemicals giant BASF raised its 2026 profit outlook for the second time this year after hiking prices to clients following the outbreak of the Iran war.
why: BASF SE is one of the world's largest chemical producers, and upward revisions in guidance serve as an indicator of pricing power and cost-pass-through capability during geopolitical supply shocks.

impacts.name: BASF
impacts.why: Higher price guidance reflects improved margin expectations following client price hikes.

why_moved: Higher profit guidance and price hikes directly improve expected earnings per share, driving positive revisions among equity analysts.
